messages:
Priya (People Ops): Quick note — offer for Maria Chen (Sr Eng) needs exception routing. Manager requesting one-band uplift + $10k relocation + earlier start (3/25 vs standard 4/1). Can we route approvals? Any immediate blockers?
Jules - Hiring: Can manager paste the written justification here? need to attach market comp data.
Marco (Hiring Manager): TL;DR: competing offer, candidate requires earlier start 3/25, relocation immediate. Market says candidate is L4 comp; we want to match to secure. Manager rationale attached: 'critical infra expertise + product lead'.
Priya (People Ops): Please fill the payband-exemption form: https://internal.redwood/payband-exempt and attach comp docs. Routing will be: ppl-ops -> finance -> comp-committee -> exec (if >1 band).
Sam (Finance): FYI finance prefers capped uplift. $10k relocation OK. Full band uplift triggers budget review — what's the total comp delta?
Marco (Hiring Manager): Delta ~ $12k base + relocation. Candidate will decline if we don't match.
Lina (People Ops): If we need faster routing, I'll escalate to comp-committee now. @Onboard-bot will hold start date until approvals done.
Onboard-bot: Heads up — pending approvals will block standard equipment/relocation provisioning. Ticket will be created when approvals complete.
Jules - Hiring: @Legal Team any relocation contract addendum needed? Also confirm equity remains same.
Legal Team: No legal sign-off required if equity unchanged. Ops to review the relocation SOW.
Priya (People Ops): Ok folks — voting time. Approve one-band uplift + $10k relocation + start 3/25? Reply with :+1: or :no_entry_sign:
Sam (Finance): :+1: on $10k relocation; prefer 5% base uplift instead of full band if possible.
Marco (Hiring Manager): Candidate prefers full band. Market risk high; prefer full band. :+1:
Jules - Hiring: Attached market comp PDF and candidate notes. Escalating to comp-committee for 24h turnaround.
Comp-Committee Bot: New case created: PR-2026-987 — reviewers: Kendra, Omar, Mei. Deadline 24h.
Kendra (VP Product): Reviewed materials — approve band uplift to match market and retention. :+1:
Priya (People Ops): Official: comp-committee approved band uplift and $10k relocation. Proceed with offer and target start 3/25. I'll file the approval ticket and update ATS. Closing thread.
